#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""tools/inlog_fmt.py: decode an editor command 38 INLOG reply and print it in plain words."""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "tools"))
import inlog_fmt as f  # noqa: E402


def w5(v):
    return [(v >> s) & 0x7F for s in (0, 7, 14, 21)] + [(v >> 28) & 0x0F]


def reply(now, ents, vel, ch):
    r = [len(ents)] + w5(now)
    for ms, w in ents:
        r += w5(ms) + w5(w)
    return r + vel + ch


vel = [0] * 40
ch = [0] * 40
vel[0x20], vel[0x21], ch[0x21] = 69, 0x0B, 14
ents = [(1000, 2 << 24 | 3), (1500, 1 << 24 | 0x90 << 16 | 0x20 << 8 | 69),
        (1510, 1 << 24 | 0x9E << 16 | 0x21 << 8 | 0x0B), (1600, 3 << 24 | 0x80 << 16 | 0x20 << 8 | 0x7F),
        (1700, 0 << 24 | 0x90 << 16 | 0x05 << 8 | 0x45)]
p = f.parse(reply(2000, ents, vel, ch))
assert p and p[0] == 2000 and p[1] == ents and p[2] == vel and p[3] == ch
pal = f.palette()
assert pal and len(pal) == 128
t = f.text(p, pal)
s = "\n".join(t)
print(s)
assert "EDGE         link up, notify on" in t[1]
assert "BLE          note on  ch  1 (steady) note  32 (cell row 4 col 0) vel 69 (0x45, " in t[2]
assert "ch 15 (blink)" in t[3] and "BLE NO CELL  note off" in t[4] and "vel 0 (off)" in t[4]
assert t[5].strip().split()[2] == "USB" and t[1].strip().startswith("-1.000 s")
assert f.parse(reply(5, [(0xFFFFFFFB, 2 << 24)], vel, ch)) and "-0.010 s" in f.text(f.parse(reply(5, [(0xFFFFFFFB, 2 << 24)], vel, ch)))[1]
assert f.colour_name(0xFF00FF) == "magenta" and f.colour_name(0x0000FF) == "blue"
assert f.colour_name(0x000019) == "dim blue" and f.colour_name(0) == "off" and f.colour_name(0xFFFFFF) == "white"
full = [(3000 + i, 0 << 24 | 0x90 << 16 | (i % 40) << 8 | 1) for i in range(64)]   # a full ring: 64 entries
pf = f.parse(reply(4000, full, vel, ch))
assert pf and pf[1] == full and f.text(pf, pal)[0].startswith("INLOG: 64 entries")
assert len(reply(4000, full, vel, ch)) + 5 + 1 <= 732   # + header and F7: it fits ed_out (editor.c)
assert f.parse([2] + w5(1)) is None                   # a short reply
assert f.text(None)[0].startswith("INLOG: no reply")

def w4(v):
    return [(v >> s) & 0x7F for s in (0, 7, 14, 21)]


shadow = [0] * 16
sent = [0] * 16
shadow[3] = sent[3] = 0x00007F            # GRB: blue 127
sent[5] = 0x007F00                        # GRB: red 127, but the shadow is dark
pp = f.parse_pads([1, 0] + sum((w4(v) for v in shadow + sent), []))
assert pp == (0, shadow, sent)
t2 = f.pads_text(pp, [0] * 40)
print("\n".join(t2))
assert "sent   0,  0,127 (blue)" in t2[4] and "MISMATCH" not in t2[4]
assert "MISMATCH" in t2[6] and "sent 127,  0,  0 (red)" in t2[6]
assert "WARNING: all clip cells are off, but 2 pads show a colour" in t2[-1]
assert f.parse_pads([1, 0, 1]) is None and f.pads_text(None)[0].startswith("PADS: no reply")
print("PASS INLOG reply decode and text")

assert "SMC          MIDI BF 28 64" in f.entry_text(100, 100, 0x04BF2864, None)
assert "SMC          MMC command 24" in f.entry_text(100, 100, 0x04F01800, None)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
# Copyright (C) 2026 Leo Kuroshita (@kurogedelic), Hügelton Instruments
"""Render the bitmap fonts to a C header (assets/fonts/):
  XS / S / B / M / L: Terminus 12, 16, 16 bold, 24 bold, 32 bold (BDF, SIL OFL 1.1); see SIZES. TTF fonts also work through render()
(anti-aliased, tabular figures via the OpenType `tnum` feature).

Glyph format: per glyph an advance width, a bitmap width and an offset; the
bitmap starts FONT_PAD pixels left of the pen position (room for side
bearings); rows top to bottom, 2 pixels per byte (high nibble first),
alpha 0..15. Each glyph's packed bytes use lossless PackBits: a control byte
0..127 introduces that many + 1 literal bytes; 128..255 repeats the following
byte (control & 127) + 1 times. Glyph metrics and all coverage values are unchanged.
"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, features as PILFeatures

FONTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "assets" / "fonts"
# (name, file, px, scale, pixel, first, last): pixel fonts are rendered without
# anti-aliasing at their design size and enlarged by an integer factor
# X0X: six roles, T (the footer: capitals, digits), XS (grid labels, units, hints), S (body), B (headers, names, the selected
# row), M (knob values) and L (the big readout: numbers only, space to '9', to keep its size down). Each set gives them a face and a pixel size,
# chosen so the line height stays near the layout's 12 / 16 / 24 / 32. X0X_FONTSET picks one.
# A TTF entry "file.ttf@wght=600" sets a variable font's axis.
FONTSETS = {
    "terminus": [("T", "ter-u12n.bdf", 12, 1, True, 32, 95),
                 ("XS", "ter-u12n.bdf", 12, 1, True, 32, 126),
                 ("S", "ter-u16n.bdf", 16, 1, True, 32, 126),
                 ("B", "ter-u16b.bdf", 16, 1, True, 32, 126),
                 ("M", "ter-u24b.bdf", 24, 1, True, 32, 95),
                 ("L", "ter-u32b.bdf", 32, 1, True, 32, 57)],
    "barlow": [("T", "BarlowSemiCondensed-SemiBold.ttf", 10, 1, False, 32, 95),
               ("XS", "BarlowSemiCondensed-SemiBold.ttf", 12, 1, False, 32, 126),
               ("S", "BarlowSemiCondensed-Medium.ttf", 15, 1, False, 32, 126),
               ("B", "BarlowSemiCondensed-Bold.ttf", 15, 1, False, 32, 126),
               ("M", "BarlowSemiCondensed-SemiBold.ttf", 23, 1, False, 32, 95),
               ("L", "BarlowSemiCondensed-Bold.ttf", 31, 1, False, 32, 57)],
    "inter": [("T", "Inter[opsz,wght].ttf@wght=600", 9, 1, False, 32, 95),
              ("XS", "Inter[opsz,wght].ttf@wght=600", 11, 1, False, 32, 126),
              ("S", "Inter[opsz,wght].ttf@wght=500", 14, 1, False, 32, 126),
              ("B", "Inter[opsz,wght].ttf@wght=700", 14, 1, False, 32, 126),
              ("M", "Inter[opsz,wght].ttf@wght=650", 21, 1, False, 32, 95),
              ("L", "Inter[opsz,wght].ttf@wght=700", 29, 1, False, 32, 57)],
    "rajdhani": [("XS", "Rajdhani-Bold.ttf", 14, 1, False, 32, 126),
                 ("S", "Rajdhani-SemiBold.ttf", 17, 1, False, 32, 126),
                 ("B", "Rajdhani-Bold.ttf", 17, 1, False, 32, 126),
                 ("M", "Rajdhani-Bold.ttf", 26, 1, False, 32, 95),
                 ("L", "Rajdhani-Bold.ttf", 35, 1, False, 32, 95)],
    "chakra": [("XS", "ChakraPetch-SemiBold.ttf", 11, 1, False, 32, 126),
               ("S", "ChakraPetch-Medium.ttf", 14, 1, False, 32, 126),
               ("B", "ChakraPetch-Bold.ttf", 14, 1, False, 32, 126),
               ("M", "ChakraPetch-SemiBold.ttf", 21, 1, False, 32, 95),
               ("L", "ChakraPetch-Bold.ttf", 29, 1, False, 32, 95)],
}
import os  # noqa: E402
FONTSET = os.environ.get("X0X_FONTSET", "barlow")    # the others need X0X_FONT_DIRS (not in assets/)
FONTDIRS = [Path(p) for p in os.environ.get("X0X_FONT_DIRS", "").split(":") if p]
SIZES = FONTSETS[FONTSET]
PAD = 2


def upscale(px_, w, h, scale):
    """integer nearest-neighbour enlargement of a w x h glyph"""
    if scale == 1:
        return px_
    big = []
    for y in range(h):
        row = []
        for x in range(w):
            row += [px_[y * w + x]] * scale
        big += row * scale
    return big


def render_bdf(path, scale, first, last):
    """BDF bitmap font (Terminus 8x16): exact pixels, cell = the font bounding box."""
    lines = path.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()
    fbb = next(l for l in lines if l.startswith("FONTBOUNDINGBOX")).split()
    cw, ch, fx, fy = int(fbb[1]), int(fbb[2]), int(fbb[3]), int(fbb[4])
    base = ch + fy                                     # rows above the baseline
    glyphs, i = {}, 0
    while i < len(lines):
        if lines[i].startswith("ENCODING"):
            code = int(lines[i].split()[1])
            j = i
            while not lines[j].startswith("BBX"):
                j += 1
            bw, bh, bx, by = map(int, lines[j].split()[1:5])
            dw = cw
            k = i
            while not lines[k].startswith("BITMAP"):
                if lines[k].startswith("DWIDTH"):
                    dw = int(lines[k].split()[1])
                k += 1
            rows = [int(r, 16) for r in lines[k + 1:k + 1 + bh]]
            nbits = ((bw + 7) // 8) * 8
            cell = [0] * (cw * ch)
            top = base - (by + bh)
            for r, bits in enumerate(rows):
                for c in range(bw):
                    if bits >> (nbits - 1 - c) & 1:
                        x, y = bx + c, top + r
                        if 0 <= x < cw and 0 <= y < ch:
                            cell[y * cw + x] = 15
            glyphs[code] = (dw, cell)
            i = k + bh
        i += 1
    if last >= 0xDC and 0xDC not in glyphs and ord("U") in glyphs:      # Ü for "HÜGELTON": U with dots on its top row
        dw, cell = glyphs[ord("U")]
        cell = cell[:]
        lit = [x for y in range(ch) for x in range(cw) if cell[y * cw + x]]
        if lit:
            top = min(y for y in range(ch) for x in range(cw) if cell[y * cw + x])
            for x in range(cw):
                cell[top * cw + x] = 15 if x in (min(lit), max(lit)) else 0
            for x in range(cw):
                cell[(top + 1) * cw + x] = 0
            glyphs[0xDC] = (dw, cell)
    missing = [chr(c) for c in range(first, min(last, 126) + 1) if c not in glyphs]
    if missing:
        print(f"font {path.name}: no glyph for {''.join(missing)!r} (drawn as '?')")
    out = []
    for c in range(first, last + 1):
        dw, cell = glyphs.get(c, glyphs[ord("?")])
        bw = cw + 2 * PAD                              # keep the PAD convention of the TTF path
        px_ = []
        for y in range(ch):
            px_ += [0] * PAD + cell[y * cw:(y + 1) * cw] + [0] * PAD
        out.append((dw * scale, bw * scale, upscale(px_, bw, ch, scale)))
    return ch * scale, out


def font_path(name):
    for d in [FONTS, *FONTDIRS]:
        if (d / name).exists():
            return d / name
    raise SystemExit(f"gen_font: {name} not in {FONTS} or X0X_FONT_DIRS")


def render(ttf, px, scale, pixel, first, last):
    if ttf.endswith(".bdf"):
        return render_bdf(font_path(ttf), scale, first, last)
    name, _, var = ttf.partition("@")
    font = ImageFont.truetype(str(font_path(name)), px)
    if var:                                            # a variable font: "wght=600"
        axes = dict(kv.split("=") for kv in var.split(","))
        names = [a["name"] if isinstance(a["name"], str) else a["name"].decode() for a in font.get_variation_axes()]
        font.set_variation_by_axes([float(axes.get(n.lower()[:4], axes.get(n, 0)) or a["default"])
                                    for n, a in zip(names, font.get_variation_axes())])
    # Pillow only accepts OpenType feature arguments when it was built with
    # libraqm. Keep the default tabular-number layout on lean macOS installs
    # too: center each proportional digit in the widest digit cell.
    raqm = PILFeatures.check("raqm")
    feats = ["tnum"] if not pixel and raqm else None
    tabular_width = (max(int(round(font.getlength(chr(c)))) for c in range(ord("0"), ord("9") + 1))
                     if not pixel and not raqm else None)
    asc, desc = font.getmetrics()
    top = max(0, font.getbbox("A8|(", features=feats)[1] - 1)
    h = asc + desc - top
    glyphs = []
    for c in range(first, last + 1):
        ch = chr(c)
        glyph_adv = int(round(font.getlength(ch, features=feats)))
        adv = tabular_width if tabular_width is not None and ch.isdigit() else glyph_adv
        bw = adv + 2 * PAD
        img = Image.new("L", (bw, asc + desc), 0)
        x = PAD + max(0, (adv - glyph_adv) // 2) if adv != glyph_adv else PAD
        ImageDraw.Draw(img).text((x, 0), ch, font=font, fill=255, features=feats)
        img = img.crop((0, top, bw, top + h))
        px_ = [(15 if v >= 128 else 0) if pixel else min(15, (v + 8) // 17) for v in img.tobytes()]
        glyphs.append((adv * scale, bw * scale, upscale(px_, bw, h, scale)))
    return h * scale, glyphs


# X0X: the characters a face is ever drawn with, where that is fewer than its range: the others are
# empty (no width, no bitmap). M shows knob values that are words (OFF, C#3, FWD, 1/16, LP 40%).
KEEP = {"M": " #%+-./0123456789:ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"}
# X0X: the lower-case letters that the firmware's own texts use (units: Hz dB k ms bpm bar st x).
# In XS, S and B every other lower-case letter (and `{|}~) draws with the upper-case bitmap and width,
# as gfx.c glyph() does for a face without lower case. Identical bitmaps are stored once.
LOWER_KEEP = set("abdkmprstxz")
LOWER_FOLD = {"XS", "S", "B"}


def pack_glyph(raw):
    """Bounded byte runs, independently decodable at every glyph offset."""
    out, i = [], 0
    while i < len(raw):
        run = 1
        while i + run < len(raw) and run < 128 and raw[i + run] == raw[i]:
            run += 1
        if run >= 3:
            out.extend((127 + run, raw[i]))
            i += run
            continue
        start = i
        i += run
        while i < len(raw) and i - start < 128:
            run = 1
            while i + run < len(raw) and run < 128 and raw[i + run] == raw[i]:
                run += 1
            if run >= 3:
                break
            i += min(run, 128 - (i - start))
        out.extend((i - start - 1, *raw[start:i]))
    return out


def main(out, compressed=True):
    if not PILFeatures.check("raqm"):
        print("font renderer: Pillow has no libraqm; using centered tabular-digit metrics")
    lines = [f"/* generated by tools/gen_font.py: font set {FONTSET} */",
             "#pragma once", "#include <stdint.h>", f"#define FONT_PAD {PAD}  /* x scale for L, see below */", ""]
    if compressed:
        lines.append("#define FONT_PACKBITS 1")
    for name, ttf, px, scale, pixel, first, last in SIZES:
        h, glyphs = render(ttf, px, scale, pixel, first, last)
        if name in KEEP:
            glyphs = [g if chr(first + i) in KEEP[name] else (0, 0, []) for i, g in enumerate(glyphs)]
        if name in LOWER_FOLD:
            fold = {"`": "?", "{": "?", "|": "?", "}": "?", "~": "?"}
            glyphs = [glyphs[ord(fold.get(chr(first + i), chr(first + i).upper())) - first]
                      if (chr(first + i).islower() and chr(first + i) not in LOWER_KEEP) or chr(first + i) in fold
                      else g for i, g in enumerate(glyphs)]
        data, offs, seen = [], [], {}
        for adv, bw, g in glyphs:
            key = (bw, tuple(g))
            if key in seen:                                # the same bitmap: store it once
                offs.append(seen[key])
                continue
            seen[key] = len(data)
            offs.append(len(data))
            raw = []
            for y in range(h):
                row = g[y * bw:(y + 1) * bw] + [0]
                for x in range(0, bw, 2):
                    raw.append((row[x] << 4) | row[x + 1])
            data.extend(pack_glyph(raw) if compressed else raw)
        assert len(data) < 65536
        lines.append(f"static const uint8_t FONT_{name}_DATA[{len(data)}] = {{")
        for i in range(0, len(data), 24):
            lines.append("    " + ", ".join(f"0x{b:02x}" for b in data[i:i + 24]) + ",")
        lines.append("};")
        lines.append(f"static const uint16_t FONT_{name}_OFF[{len(offs)}] = {{" + ", ".join(map(str, offs)) + "};")
        lines.append(f"static const uint8_t FONT_{name}_ADV[{len(glyphs)}] = {{" +
                     ", ".join(str(a) for a, _, _ in glyphs) + "};")
        lines.append(f"static const uint8_t FONT_{name}_BW[{len(glyphs)}] = {{" +
                     ", ".join(str(b) for _, b, _ in glyphs) + "};")
        lines.append(f"static const felucca_font_t FONT_{name} = {{ {h}, {PAD * scale}, {first}, {last}, "
                     f"FONT_{name}_ADV, FONT_{name}_BW, FONT_{name}_OFF, FONT_{name}_DATA }};")
        lines.append("")
        print(f"font {name}: {ttf} {px}px h {h}, digit adv {glyphs[ord('0') - first][0]}, {len(data)} B")
    print(f"font set {FONTSET}: {sum(len(l) for l in lines if l.startswith('    0x')) // 6} B (approx)")
    Path(out).write_text("\n".join(lines))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1])
